name: Aldeacipreste (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aldeacipreste (a cypress, a bull and a cross on white and red).
history: The municipal flag is rectangular, of proportion 2:3, tierced in three fesses of blue, white and red, with the municipal arms at the centre of the white fess.

features.role: Aldeacipreste arms — cypress, bull and cross on white and red
